title: Respect .gitignore - exclude ignored files/folders
description: CRITICAL: Parse .gitignore file and exclude all ignored files and folders from analysis, refactoring, and cleanup. Never modify, move, or process files that are in .gitignore (build artifacts, __pycache__, venv, .env, IDE configs, etc.).
verification: Verification script confirms no .gitignore files are touched

title: Code inventory: Identify all BTQ Render Engine files
description: Complete inventory of all Python files, modules, classes and functions across the different applications. Document dependencies and mark redundancies. Skip files/folders in .gitignore.
verification: Complete list of all components with dependency tree created

title: Identify functional overlaps
description: Find all duplicated functions, classes and code blocks between the 2-3 applications. Document commonalities and differences. Only analyze tracked files.
verification: Table with all duplicates and their usage created

title: Extract core functionality
description: Define the essential render engine features that must be included in the final application. Mark non-essential features.
verification: Feature matrix with must-have, nice-to-have and deprecated features

title: Design modular architecture
description: Plan clean project structure with clear separation: Core Engine, Rendering, UI, Utils, Config. Define dependency injection pattern.
verification: Architecture diagram and folder structure documented

title: API interface design
description: Define unified API for all render operations. Establish clear interfaces between modules.
verification: API documentation with all public methods and parameters

title: Create core engine module
description: Build central render engine as reusable module. Consolidate all common functions from old applications here.
verification: Core engine module runs standalone with unit tests

title: Consolidate rendering pipeline
description: Migrate all rendering logic from various apps into unified pipeline. Unify shader, texture handling, buffer management.
verification: Rendering pipeline produces identical outputs as before

title: Merge utilities
description: Migrate all helper functions, math utils, file I/O and logging from apps into common utils module. Eliminate duplicates.
verification: Utils module complete with docstrings and type hints

title: Unify configuration management
description: Migrate all config files (JSON, YAML, INI) into unified system. Create central config class with validation.
verification: All settings accessible through one config class

title: Consolidate UI/frontend
description: If GUI exists: Merge all UI components into unified interface. Establish consistent look & feel.
verification: One unified UI frontend working

title: Eliminate dead code
description: Remove all unused functions, imports and variables. Use code coverage tool for identification. Only process files not in .gitignore.
verification: Coverage report shows only used code

title: Unify code style
description: Establish PEP 8 compliance. Run Black formatter and Flake8 linter over entire codebase (excluding .gitignore files).
verification: Flake8 and Black pass without errors

title: Add type hints
description: Add complete type hints to all functions and methods. Run MyPy validation. Skip .gitignore files.
verification: MyPy passes without type errors

title: Main application entry point
description: Create central main.py that orchestrates all modules. Integrate command-line arguments parser.
verification: python main.py starts the complete application

title: Dependency management
description: Create requirements.txt or pyproject.toml with all exact dependencies. Document virtual environment setup.
verification: Fresh install in new venv works

title: Create unit tests
description: Build test suite for core engine, renderer and utils. Aim for minimum 70% code coverage.
verification: Pytest runs with >70% coverage

title: Integration tests
description: Create end-to-end tests for complete rendering workflows. Cover various use cases.
verification: All integration tests pass

title: Code documentation
description: Add meaningful docstrings to all modules, classes and functions. Format Sphinx-compatible.
verification: Sphinx can generate complete API documentation

title: README and user guide
description: Comprehensive README.md with installation, quick start, features. Separate USER_GUIDE.md for advanced usage.
verification: New user can start with README alone

title: Architecture documentation
description: Technical documentation of architecture, design decisions and data flow. Include diagrams.
verification: Developer can understand architecture without code review

title: Performance profiling
description: Identify bottlenecks with cProfile. Optimize critical paths.
verification: Performance report with before/after metrics

title: Memory optimization
description: Find and fix memory leaks. Optimize garbage collection for large render jobs.
verification: Memory profiler shows stable memory usage

title: Archive old applications
description: Move the 2-3 old applications to archive/ folder. Don't delete for reference. Add archive/ to .gitignore if needed.
verification: Old apps in archive/, new app works standalone

title: Create migration guide
description: Document how to migrate from old apps to new one. List breaking changes.
verification: Users can migrate independently

title: Final review and cleanup
description: Complete code review. Remove last TODOs. Set version 1.0.0 tag. Verify .gitignore compliance.
verification: Human review: Everything clean, documented and functional
